pass_a_gloss: Every death for Christ glorifies; manner hallowed by confession.
pass_b_english: Know this too: the word spoken through John we learned, saying, 'These things said he, signifying by what death he shall glorify God.' (John 21:19) Every death for Christ glorifies the Father — whether by sword or fire or beasts or bonds. Let the manner be what God wills; ours is the willingness. For the confession hallows every manner, and every manner perfects the confessor.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Exhortatio exists; nothing to compare.
